# Enterprise-only endpoints called by the dashboard that still return an untyped dict.
#
# The personal ratchet cannot see these: _register_routes gates the tenant /
# rbac / sso / quotas / n8n / licenses / compliance routers behind
# FeatureFlag.MULTI_USER, so with no enterprise license they are absent from
# app.openapi() and the personal gate's `matched` set never contains them.
# Burn-down list for tests/test_enterprise_response_models.py: delete a line
# when the endpoint declares a response_model. The gate fails in both
# directions (new gap, stale line) and the count below may only shrink.
#
# 2026-10-30: 31 → 14. The 17 tenant / rbac / quotas lines are modelled in
# routers/{tenant,rbac,quotas}_schemas.py. The 14 left all live in the three
# routers that import the commercial overlay at module level (sso / n8n /
# licenses): they need a MAOS-side change plus a re-signed integrity manifest,
# so they are a separate batch, not a forgotten tail.
# Format: METHOD PATH

DELETE /api/sso/providers/{}
GET /api/licenses/list
GET /api/licenses/{}
GET /api/n8n/executions/{}
GET /api/n8n/health
GET /api/n8n/workflows
GET /api/sso/providers

POST /api/licenses/{}/renew
POST /api/licenses/{}/revoke
POST /api/n8n/workflows/{}/trigger
POST /api/sso/providers
